description: Source code implementing reference cache management and iteration for a Git-like repository system, including functions for creating, freeing, sorting, searching, and iterating over reference entries and directories.

classes.name: struct ref_dir
classes.description: Represents a directory of references, containing entries and metadata.

classes.name: struct ref_entry
classes.description: Represents a single reference entry, which can be a direct reference or a subdirectory.

classes.name: struct string_slice
classes.description: Helper structure for string comparison in search functions.

classes.name: struct cache_ref_iterator_level
classes.description: Represents a level in the recursive reference iteration stack.

classes.name: struct cache_ref_iterator
classes.description: Encapsulates the state for iterating over references in the cache, including recursion levels and prefix filtering.

methods.name: add_entry_to_dir
methods.description: Adds a reference entry to a directory, maintaining sorted order if applicable.

methods.name: get_ref_dir
methods.description: Retrieves or loads the directory associated with a reference entry.

methods.name: create_ref_entry
methods.description: Creates a new reference entry with specified name, referent, object ID, and flags.

methods.name: create_ref_cache
methods.description: Creates a new reference cache object with a given reference store and fill function.

methods.name: free_ref_cache
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a reference cache.

methods.name: create_dir_entry
methods.description: Creates a directory reference entry, marked as incomplete.

methods.name: search_ref_dir
methods.description: Searches for a reference entry within a directory by name.

methods.name: find_containing_dir
methods.description: Finds the directory that should contain a given reference name, recursing into subdirectories.

methods.name: is_dup_ref
methods.description: Checks if two references are duplicates, warning if same name and same oid, error if conflicting.

methods.name: sort_ref_dir
methods.description: Sorts directory entries and removes duplicates.

methods.name: prime_ref_dir
methods.description: Recursively loads references from a directory that may match a prefix.

methods.name: cache_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing references with optional prefix filtering.
